build_ObservationModel_64x64: build an ObservationModel for 64x64 observations with a specified belief size, state size, and hidden size
build_ObservationModel_96x96: build an ObservationModel for 96x96 observations using ConvTranspose2d layers to decode latent features into images
run_forward_feature: run forward_feature on a tensor through the fc1 layer and conv_head to produce decoded observation output
run_forward: run forward on a LatentState to get a Normal distribution over reconstructed observations with configurable stddev
review_ObservationModel_conv_architectur: review the ObservationModel conv_head architecture that uses BottledModule to handle batched ConvTranspose2d decoding
